Medical Science Liaison, Dermatology
Requirements: Degree level education with ability to comprehend science and medicine; full understanding of UK healthcare environment; proven track record in medical sales; experience in primary and secondary care and key account management; high IT competence
Microsoft Office
What you'll bring
- Educated to degree level (or equivalent), with the ability to comprehend science and medicine
- Full understanding of the UK healthcare environment and its commercial implications for dermo-cosmetic companies
- Proven experience delivering impactful medical educational events, live and virtually
- Exceptional interpersonal, communication, influencing, and negotiation skills
- Proactive and results-oriented, able to work autonomously and as part of a team
- High level of IT competence for reporting systems and Microsoft Office applications
Desirable
- Proven track record in medical sales, ideally within dermatology
- Experience in primary care, secondary care, and key account management is highly desirable
What we offer
